text: Speak in an accent for the next 3 rounds.
Let the person on your right choose your next drink.
Do your best impression of another player.
Sing the [b]chorus[/b] of the last song you listened to.
Send a random emoji to the 5th person in your contacts.
Let the person to your left pick your next profile picture for 24 hours.
Show the group the last screenshot you took.
[i]Serenade[/i] the person on your right for 10 seconds.

Text your most recent ex-partner an embarrassing message right now. It doesn't matter what it says. The only rule is you have to send it before this card moves on and you cannot delete it for the rest of the night.
Do a shot without using your hands.
Let the group write one sentence on your social media of choice.
Call a friend and confess a [b]guilty pleasure[/b] out loud.
Let the group send one text from your phone to anyone they choose.
Call the 3rd person in your favorites and say "I love you."
Let the group scroll through your last 20 photos.
Post a [b]selfie[/b] with no filter and no caption right now.
